blocks.content: Mastering fundamental terminology is the single most effective shortcut to eliminating wrong options in competitive exams.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Understanding core terminologies is crucial for solving both direct and elimination-based questions in prelims.
Economic terms like Repo Rate, Reverse Repo Rate, and Inflation directly impact policy and national development.
Polity terms such as Habeas Corpus and Judicial Review form the foundation of constitutional rights questions.
Environmental terms like Bio-magnification and Eutrophication are frequently tested in recent paper trends.

rows: Rate at which RBI lends short-term funds to commercial banks against securities
Writ issued to produce a detained person before the court to test detention legality
Excessive richness of nutrients in a water body causing dense plant growth and hypoxia

items: Questions often confuse Repo Rate with Bank Rate; remember Repo Rate involves short-term securities repurchase agreements.
Distinguish clearly between Eutrophication (nutrient enrichment) and Bio-accumulation (pollutant buildup in an organism).
Writ jurisdictions under Article 32 (Supreme Court) and Article 226 (High Court) carry distinct geographical and fundamental scope differences.
